findings.reason: I confirmed in the diff that every batch in CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags calls r.log.Error with the full ids slice and an err that is always nil, even when nothing went wrong; this is clearly leftover debug logging that will flood error logs on healthy instances.

I confirmed that cleanup.go:77 changed the ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute; it drives all eight cleanup jobs while the timeout is still 9 minutes, so this looks like an unrelated testing leftover that multiplies DB load tenfold.

I confirmed that the SQLite inline branch builds the ID list with repeated fmt.Sprintf on a growing string, which is O(n^2); with 32767 IDs that copies gigabytes per batch, a real but minor perf defect on an uncommon config path.

I confirmed that each subtest now creates fresh data and wipes the tables in t.Cleanup, so the 'running the max count delete again' case no longer tests a repeated run; this is a correct but marginal test-coverage and naming issue.
